title: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy (Celesta Etude)
prompt_override: Direct a crystalline Sugar-Plum Fairy in an enchanted violet music-box theater. Keep the prelude hushed and tiptoeing, leap on the B-section woodwind accents, and unleash a golden stardust storm during the fortissimo celesta climax.

score.title: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy (Celesta Etude)
score.director_summary: A crystalline music-box ballet in four acts: we open in a hushed violet proscenium as Aurelia tiptoes to the iconic descending celesta motif, transition into buoyant syncopated leaps during the arpeggiated development, erupt into a golden stardust storm during the rapid tremolo climax, and dissolve into a suspended porcelain stillness on the final harmonic chimes.

character.name: Aurelia the Sugar-Plum Sprite
character.concept: A translucent porcelain-and-amethyst clockwork ballerina who awakens inside a velvet music box, channeling every celesta pluck and crystalline tremolo through delicate, spring-loaded ballet choreography.
character.style: Crystalline paper-cut theater with glowing filigree edges, volumetric stardust motes, and refracted prism highlights
accessories: Spun-glass tutu with gold leaf trim

sections.name: Hushed Celesta Prelude
sections.background: Dimly lit violet velvet music-box stage with slowly turning brass gears in the shadows

sections.name: Arpeggiated Woodwind & Celesta Dialogue
sections.background: Frost-etched glass arches illuminating in sync with rising arpeggio figures

sections.name: Fortissimo Crystalline Tremolo Climax
sections.background: Radiant golden-violet cathedral of refracted light beams and spinning celestial rings

sections.name: Porcelain Music-Box Dissolve
sections.mood: Wistful, fragile, winding down to stillness
sections.background: Fading twilight proscenium with a single spotlight narrowing on the porcelain pedestal

events.trigger: onset=0.79 (entry of the iconic high G-E celesta motif)
events.why: After the four plucked bass pizzicato beats set the hush, the first high celesta note enters at 2.02s; Aurelia awakens from her clockwork slumber with a crisp tiptoe step left.

events.trigger: onset=1.00 (peak accent of opening descending phrase)
events.why: The strongest onset of the prelude lands on the D# celesta accent; Aurelia performs a delicate knee-plié bounce that sends a ripple of crystal drops across the floor.

events.trigger: onset=0.83 (chromatic descending step in main theme)
events.why: As the melody creeps chromatically downward, Aurelia mirrors the harmonic tension by tiptoeing right across the stage with poised curiosity.
The descending line reaches its low questioning resolution; Aurelia raises her porcelain arms into fifth position, holding the suspense before the B-section.

events.trigger: onset=0.91 (bright ascending arpeggio burst launching Section 2)
events.why: At 9.52s the arrangement shifts into rapid upward arpeggios; Aurelia leaps into the air on the high woodwind/celesta accent, igniting the stardust particle layer.
The repeating call-and-response arpeggio peaks again at 11.52s; a brisk pirouette translates the swirling sixteenth-note figure into rotational motion.
As the repeated motif builds urgency toward the climax, Aurelia executes a syncopated grand jeté right on the downbeat accent.

events.trigger: onset=0.76 (sweeping harp/celesta glissando into the fortissimo climax)
events.why: A rapid ascending glissando at 17.0s unleashes the high-energy tremolo climax; Aurelia launches into a dazzling golden stardust spin as the camera zooms in.

events.trigger: onset=0.63 (sparse high-register bell notes in outro)
events.why: The rapid tremolos vanish into isolated, echoing music-box chimes; Aurelia slows her motion and lifts her arms in a wistful farewell arch.
On the final crystalline strike at 30.02s, Aurelia freezes in a balanced arabesque silhouette while the violet stage lights slowly fade to black.

climax.description: Following the sweeping upward glissando at 17.0s, the texture doubles in density and brightness (avg_energy 0.421, avg_brightness 0.455) with continuous mandolin-like celesta tremolos descending and ascending through dramatic harmonic shifts.
climax.visual_boost: Golden stardust storm + 1.25x dynamic camera zoom + amethyst halo bloom + continuous ribbon trails
